_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Unresolved coil with downside breakers offset by liquidity/MVRV support keeps the score inside Anxiety; base-rate allows movement but evidence does not yet justify a ±1 rung call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Anxiety; narrative tape is net-selling and pattern implies bottom/accumulation upside; consensus follows higher-trust analyst HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55, 30d momentum stays mild chop (-8% to +3%), ETF flows remain dead, no CVD rebound
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows and CVD reclaim neutral (up toward Complacency) or F&G <40 with 30d momentum <-10% (down toward Denial)
